013/**
014 * Attribute payload for creating or updating a Select AI vector index.
015 * <p>
016 * Vector-index attributes configure the source content, credential, Select AI
017 * profile, text chunking, retrieval behavior, vector configuration, and other
018 * settings used by Select AI for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
019 * <p>
020 * For complete runnable sample sources that build
021 * {@code VectorIndexAttributes}, see
022 * <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/CreateVectorIndexSample.html">
023 * CreateVectorIndexSample source</a> and
024 * <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/UpdateVectorIndexAttributesSample.html">
025 * UpdateVectorIndexAttributesSample source</a>.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * The SDK performs basic, deterministic validation and normalization where
029 * the constraint is part of the Java API contract. Blank string values are
030 * normalized to {@code null}. The SDK also prevents database-managed
031 * attributes from being supplied where they are not allowed. In particular,
032 * {@code pipeline_name} is generated by Oracle Database for a vector index
033 * and cannot be specified when using the create builder; attempting to set it
034 * results in an {@link IllegalArgumentException}.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * The SDK does not duplicate provider-specific, database-version-specific,
038 * value-range, or other database-side semantic validation. These validations
039 * are delegated to {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI} and Oracle Database. Therefore, an
040 * attribute value accepted by the SDK may still be rejected by the database
041 * based on the selected profile, vector provider, database version, or other
042 * database-side requirements.
043 *
044 * <p>
045 * Use {@link #builder()} when constructing attributes for vector-index
046 * creation and {@link #updateBuilder()} when constructing attributes for
047 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI.UPDATE_VECTOR_INDEX}. Attributes are included in the
048 * generated payload only when explicitly set by the caller.
049 *
050 * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/autonomous-database/serverless/adbsb/dbms-cloud-ai-package.html#GUID-CB37AB86-B625-4798-A3F4-8DD6DBA8B491">
051 *      DBMS_CLOUD_AI.CREATE_VECTOR_INDEX procedure</a>
052 * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/autonomous-database/serverless/adbsb/select-ai-retrieval-augmented-generation.html">
053 *      Select AI with Retrieval Augmented Generation</a>
054 */
055public final class VectorIndexAttributes {
056
057    /** Size of text chunks loaded into the vector store. */
058    private final Integer chunkSize;
059    /** Overlap between adjacent text chunks. */
060    private final Integer chunkOverlap;
061    /** Whether Select AI should include source citations. */
062    private final Boolean enableSources;
063    /** Object storage or file location containing source documents. */
064    private final String location;
065    /** Number of matches returned for retrieval. */
066    private final Integer matchLimit;
067    /** Credential name used to read object storage content. */
068    private final String objectStorageCredentialName;
069    /** DBMS_CLOUD_PIPELINE pipeline name for update/read payloads. */
070    private final String pipelineName;
071    /** Name of the AI profile which is used for
072     embedding source data and user prompts */
073    private final String profileName;
074    /** Refresh interval in minutes. */
075    private final Integer refreshRate;
076    /** Similarity threshold for retrieved matches. */
077    private final Double similarityThreshold;
078    /** Vector distance metric such as COSINE. */
079    private final String vectorDistanceMetric;
080    /** Vector database provider such as oracle. */
081    private final String vectorDbProvider;
082    /** Embedding vector dimension when explicitly configured. */
083    private final Integer vectorDimension;
084    /** Vector table name backing the index. */
085    private final String vectorTableName;
086
087
088    private VectorIndexAttributes(Builder builder) {
089        this.chunkSize = builder.chunkSize;
090        this.chunkOverlap = builder.chunkOverlap;
091        this.enableSources = builder.enableSources;
092        this.location = builder.location;
093        this.matchLimit = builder.matchLimit;
094        this.objectStorageCredentialName = builder.objectStorageCredentialName;
095        this.pipelineName = builder.pipelineName;
096        this.profileName = builder.profileName;
097        this.refreshRate = builder.refreshRate;
098        this.similarityThreshold = builder.similarityThreshold;
099        this.vectorDistanceMetric = builder.vectorDistanceMetric;
100        this.vectorDbProvider = builder.vectorDbProvider;
101        this.vectorDimension = builder.vectorDimension;
102        this.vectorTableName = builder.vectorTableName;
103    }
104
105    /**
106     * Creates a builder for vector-index create payloads.
107     * <p>
108     * The builder does not inject database default values. Attributes are
109     * included in the generated JSON only when explicitly set by the caller.
110     * Database-side validation of required and semantically valid attributes is
111     * performed by Oracle Database.
112     *
113     * @return new builder for vector-index create attribute values
114     */
115    public static Builder builder() {
116        return new Builder(true);
117    }
118
119    /**
120     * Creates a builder for update payloads.
121     * <p>
122     * Unlike {@link #builder()}, this builder does not populate create-time
123     * defaults such as {@code chunk_size}. Set only the attributes intended for
124     * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI.UPDATE_VECTOR_INDEX}.
125     *
126     * @return new builder for vector-index update attribute values
127     */
128    public static Builder updateBuilder() {
129        return new Builder(false);
130    }
131

205     * Returns the refresh interval in minutes.

242     *
243     * @return vector dimension, or {@code null} when unset

245    public Integer getVectorDimension() {

247    }
248

250     * Returns the vector table name.
251     *
252     * @return vector table name, or {@code null} when unset
253     */
254    public String getVectorTableName() {
255        return vectorTableName;
256    }
257
258    /**
259     * Serializes attributes using DBMS_CLOUD_AI snake_case JSON names.
260     *
261     * @return JSON representation of this VectorIndexAttributes instance
262     */
263    public String toJson() {
264        ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();
265        try {
266            mapper.setPropertyNamingStrategy(PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE);
267            mapper.setDefaultPropertyInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL);
268            return mapper.writeValueAsString(this);
269        } catch (Exception e) {
270            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to serialize VectorIndexAttributes to JSON", e);
271        }
272    }
273
274    /**
275     * Builder for {@link VectorIndexAttributes}.
276     */
277    public static final class Builder {
278        /** Whether create-time required fields must be present. */
279        private final boolean createPayload;
280        /** Chunk size being assembled. */
281        private Integer chunkSize;
282        /** Chunk overlap being assembled. */
283        private Integer chunkOverlap;
284        /** Source citation flag being assembled. */
285        private Boolean enableSources;
286        /** Source content location being assembled. */
287        private String location;
288        /** Match limit being assembled. */
289        private Integer matchLimit;
290        /** Object storage credential name being assembled. */
291        private String objectStorageCredentialName;
292        /** Pipeline name being assembled. */
293        private String pipelineName;
294        /** Profile name being assembled. */
295        private String profileName;
296        /** Refresh rate being assembled. */
297        private Integer refreshRate;
298        /** Similarity threshold being assembled. */
299        private Double similarityThreshold;
300        /** Vector distance metric being assembled. */
301        private String vectorDistanceMetric;
302        /** Vector database provider being assembled. */
303        private String vectorDbProvider;
304        /** Vector dimension being assembled. */
305        private Integer vectorDimension;
306        /** Vector table name being assembled. */
307        private String vectorTableName;
308
309        private Builder(boolean createPayload) {
310            this.createPayload = createPayload;
311        }
312
313        /**
314         * Sets the text chunk size.
315         *
316         * @param chunkSize chunk size
317         * @return this builder instance
318         */
319        public Builder chunkSize(Integer chunkSize) {
320            this.chunkSize = chunkSize;
321            return this;
322        }
323
324        /**
325         * Sets the overlap between text chunks.
326         *
327         * @param chunkOverlap chunk overlap
328         * @return this builder instance
329         */
330        public Builder chunkOverlap(Integer chunkOverlap) {
331            this.chunkOverlap = chunkOverlap;
332            return this;
333        }
334
335        /**
336         * Sets whether source citations are enabled.
337         *
338         * @param enableSources source citation flag
339         * @return this builder instance
340         */
341        public Builder enableSources(Boolean enableSources) {
342            this.enableSources = enableSources;
343            return this;
344        }
345
346        /**
347         * Sets the source document location.
348         *
349         * @param location object storage or file location
350         * @return this builder instance
351         */
352        public Builder location(String location) {
353            this.location = normalize(location);
354            return this;
355        }
356
357        /**
358         * Sets the retrieval match limit.
359         *
360         * @param matchLimit match limit
361         * @return this builder instance
362         */
363        public Builder matchLimit(Integer matchLimit) {
364            this.matchLimit = matchLimit;
365            return this;
366        }
367
368        /**
369         * Sets the credential used to read object storage content.
370         *
371         * @param objectStorageCredentialName object storage credential name
372         * @return this builder instance
373         */
374        public Builder objectStorageCredentialName(String objectStorageCredentialName) {
375            this.objectStorageCredentialName = normalize(objectStorageCredentialName);
376            return this;
377        }
378
379        /**
380         * Sets the pipeline name for update payloads.
381         * <p>
382         * {@code pipeline_name} is generated by the database during vector
383         * index creation and cannot be supplied in create payloads.
384         *
385         * @param pipelineName DBMS_CLOUD_PIPELINE pipeline name
386         * @return this builder instance
387         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when used with the create builder
388         */
389        public Builder pipelineName(String pipelineName) {
390            if (createPayload) {
391                throw new IllegalArgumentException("pipelineName cannot be specified during vector index creation");
392            }
393            this.pipelineName = normalize(pipelineName);
394            return this;
395        }
396
397        /**
398         * Sets the Select AI profile used by the vector index.
399         *
400         * @param profileName Select AI profile name
401         * @return this builder instance
402         */
403        public Builder profileName(String profileName) {
404            this.profileName = normalize(profileName);
405            return this;
406        }
407
408        /**
409         * Sets the refresh interval in minutes.
410         *
411         * @param refreshRate refresh interval
412         * @return this builder instance
413         */
414        public Builder refreshRate(Integer refreshRate) {
415            this.refreshRate = refreshRate;
416            return this;
417        }
418
419        /**
420         * Sets the retrieval similarity threshold.
421         *
422         * @param similarityThreshold similarity threshold
423         * @return this builder instance
424         */
425        public Builder similarityThreshold(Double similarityThreshold) {
426            this.similarityThreshold = similarityThreshold;
427            return this;
428        }
429
430        /**
431         * Sets the vector distance metric.
432         *
433         * @param vectorDistanceMetric distance metric name
434         * @return this builder instance
435         */
436        public Builder vectorDistanceMetric(String vectorDistanceMetric) {
437            this.vectorDistanceMetric = normalize(vectorDistanceMetric);
438            return this;
439        }
440
441        /**
442         * Sets the vector database provider.
443         *
444         * @param vectorDbProvider vector database provider name
445         * @return this builder instance
446         */
447        public Builder vectorDbProvider(String vectorDbProvider) {
448            this.vectorDbProvider = normalize(vectorDbProvider);
449            return this;
450        }
451
452        /**
453         * Sets the vector dimension.
454         *
455         * @param vectorDimension vector dimension
456         * @return this builder instance
457         */
458        public Builder vectorDimension(Integer vectorDimension) {
459            this.vectorDimension = vectorDimension;
460            return this;
461        }
462
463        /**
464         * Sets the backing vector table name.
465         *
466         * @param vectorTableName vector table name
467         * @return this builder instance
468         */
469        public Builder vectorTableName(String vectorTableName) {
470            this.vectorTableName = normalize(vectorTableName);
471            return this;
472        }
473
474        /**
475         * Normalizes blank input strings to {@code null}.
476         *
477         * @param value value to trim
478         * @return trimmed value, or {@code null} when input is null/blank
479         */
480        private static String normalize(String value) {
481            if (value == null) {
482                return null;
483            }
484            String trimmed = value.trim();
485            return trimmed.isEmpty() ? null : trimmed;
486        }
487
488        /**
489         * Builds the vector index attribute payload.
490         *
491         * @return immutable VectorIndexAttributes built from validated builder state
492         */
493        public VectorIndexAttributes build() {
494            return new VectorIndexAttributes(this);
495        }
496    }
